author: TragikBolt
body: Hello. I got tempbanned for racism saying the N-word. I am truly sorry for saying this because I simply did not know this word was considered racist. Where I come from,(Detroit, U.S), everybody says this word. I am black but this did not offend me. I am very sorry for my wrong doings. Please unban because I am a true fan of avicus and I will make sure I do not say any bad words.
